events.name: The Sports Museum Tour
events.description:
The Sports Museum consists of a half-mile of exhibits at the TD Garden, the home of the Boston Bruins and Boston Celtics.
During your visit to The Sports Museum Tour, our Museum Assistants will guide you through The Sports Museum, which is located primarily on the Premium Levels 5 & 6 of TD Garden. Here you will see the treasures that we have on display evidencing the rich heritage of Boston sports and the influence of sports on the social history and evolution of Boston.

accessibility.info:
* Wheelchair accessible patrons may purchase up to 3 companion seats with each wheelchair accessible space. Please note that the mezzanine and balcony, while they can be reached via elevator, have stairs and are not accessible for wheelchair transfers.

* Limited mobility patrons may purchase limited mobility seating. Boston Opera House has an elevator which can access all levels of the theater. There are no railings on any seating aisles. The mezzanine and balcony have stairs and are not accessible for mobility impairments.

* Sight-impaired and deaf patrons may purchase sight-/hearing-impaired seating.

* Hearing-impaired patrons may purchase sight-/hearing-impaired seating, but may also be accomodated by purchasing regular availability seating and obtaining hearing-impaired devices which can be accessed at coat check upon entry. There is no charge and no need to reserve in advance; ID is required for use. We also offer ASL/OC performances, please contact 617-880-2419 for info.

venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: MGM Music Hall offers a range of accessible seating for purchase including wheelchair accessible seating, limited mobility seating, and companion seating, in addition to other accommodations that can be made upon request. For accessibility, the venue is wheelchair accessible, with easy access ramps on the first floor, as well as an elevator that provides access to all levels, and designated ADA sections on our first, third and fourth floors. If you are unable to purchase accessible seating for an upcoming concert, need additional accommodations, or have any questions about our accessibility, please reach out to our phone ambassadors at info.mgmfenway@crossroadspresents.com or by calling the venue at (617) 488-7540 for additional assistance.

Lighters are not allowed in the venue and there is absolutely NO SMOKING OR VAPING allowed per the city of Boston Ordinances. Any smoking or vaping will result in IMMEDIATE EJECTION from the event. Any medication must be accompanied by proof of prescription. This list of prohibited items is subject to change at the discretion of venue management. More information regarding prohibited items and other venue rules can be found here: https://crossroadspresents.com/pages/mgm-fenway-music-hall

accessibility.info:
* Wheelchair accessible patrons may purchase up to 3 companion seats with each wheelchair accessible space. Please note that the mezzanine and balcony, while they can be reached via elevator, have stairs and are not accessible for wheelchair transfers.

* Limited mobility patrons may purchase limited mobility seating. Boston Opera House has an elevator which can access all levels of the theater. There are no railings on any seating aisles. The mezzanine and balcony have stairs and are not accessible for mobility impairments.

* Sight-impaired and deaf patrons may purchase sight-/hearing-impaired seating.

* Hearing-impaired patrons may purchase sight-/hearing-impaired seating, but may also be accomodated by purchasing regular availability seating and obtaining hearing-impaired devices which can be accessed at coat check upon entry. There is no charge and no need to reserve in advance; ID is required for use. We also offer ASL/OC performances, please contact 617-880-2419 for info.

events.info: "Cancelled" is an original pilot written and directed by Shane Dawson starring Lily Vandermeer, Derek Hoa, Jacob Sartorius, Sally Presman, and Ryland Adams Rachel Loveman, A-list actress and America's sweetheart, is on the cusp of winning her first Oscar. The night before the ceremony a leaked audio recording of Rachel's drunken problematic tirade goes VIRAL, setting her perfect world up in flames. At the same time, Tim Harper, an out of work filmmaker, loses all hope after he yet again ruins his chance at his big break. After a chance meeting, Tim accepts a job as Rachel's personal assistant and the two begin to realize that maybe everything truly does happen for a reason. Wilbur Theatre Parking is available at the link below.
